description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Pre-Match Dri-FIT Strike children's sweatshirt is designed to accompany young footballers during their pre-match warm-up. Light and breathable fabric: Provides freshness during warm-up.
Sporty cut: Offers freedom of movement in every action.
Official Pre-Match Design: Inspired by the garment used by players before matches.
Official shield of FC Barcelona: Perfect for young Barcelona fans.
